about: Labelled routing cases for skill_intelligence.build_brief / analyse: the 10 requests of the v5.3 routing audit (lens routing, RQ-06..RQ-10), shadow cases for every defect found by the audit and by the two adversarial reviews of the v5.3 routing pass (RR-xx), and a held-out set of fresh requests whose labels (primary, off-domain groups) were written before their briefs were inspected. Superpowers are matched by case-insensitive substrings of name_en, never by SP id (ids are positional and change on rebuild). Enforced by evals/test_routing_quality.py.

keys.brief: true: build the full brief; false: analyse() only
keys.must_haves_include / must_haves_exclude: need-name prefixes that must / must not appear in analysis.must_haves
keys.must_pick_exclude: need prefix -> name keywords its must-have pick must not be
keys.rec_include_any / rec_include_all / rec_: name keywords in the recommended plan
keys.all_plans_exclude: name keywords no plan may contain
keys.plans_exclude_groups: plan groups no plan may contain
keys.verifiers_exclude: name keywords no verifier may be
keys.shortlist_top_include_any: {n, any}: one of the name keywords must be in the shortlist top n (the shortlist is ordered by the weighted score, not by fit)
keys.irrelevant: curated clearly-irrelevant name keywords for this request: the builder's full X labels (by name) plus the audit's proposals (aggregate precision gate over the recommended plans)
keys.intent: 'produce' or 'publish' (posting or pushing something that already exists)
keys.questions_include / questions_exclude: substrings that must / must not appear in some analysis.questions[].question
keys.excluded_empty: true: no superpower is excluded by the own-asset constraint layer
keys.verifiers_include_any: one of these name keywords must be a verifier
keys.rec_verify_include_any: one of these name keywords must be in the verify stage of the recommended plan
keys.irrelevant_groups: held-out cases: plan groups that are off-domain for the request (aggregate gate over the recommended plans)

aggregate.note: counts of picks in the recommended plans matching each case's curated list (or, held-out, an off-domain group); the gates are the honest measured counts (held-out: +1 because its group labels are coarse)
